method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Stocks Fall as Long-Term Yields Hit 24-Year High: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Broad market wrap tying equity weakness directly to a sharp rise in long-term yields. Within the equities framework this is a clear negative macro liquidity / rates-driven impulse (higher-for-longer rates -> pressure on multiples and risk sentiment). High relevance as it signals market-regime pressu

Equities.title: Trading Day: Stocks still in bonds' grip
Equities.reason: Market commentary explicitly links equity moves to bond market dynamics. Reinforces the dominant narrative that rising yields are the primary driver of equity performance — negative for broad risk assets with meaningful relevance.

Equities.title: Bonds set for bruising September, but stocks remain resilient
Equities.reason: Article frames stocks as relatively resilient despite bond weakness; this provides a modest counterpoint to the rates-driven negative narrative and reduces net risk-off severity. Low-medium relevance as it nuances the primary rates story.

Equities.title: China's factory activity returns to growth in September amid AI boom
Equities.reason: Chinese manufacturing moving back into expansion (linked to AI demand) is a positive cyclical / regional equity signal — supportive for Asia-exposed and global cyclical stocks. Relevant to equity demand/earnings expectations, though not dominant vs global rates theme.

Equities.title: Korean Stocks Face Early End to $40 Billion Buyback Support
Equities.reason: Loss of large buyback support is a concrete, market-specific negative for Korean equities and signals reduced corporate liquidity support — negative for regional equity flows and sentiment.

Equities.title: Indian shares set for weak October as foreign investors ramp up shorts, brokerages say
Equities.reason: Shows active de-risking by foreign investors and rising short interest — a direct negative for Indian equities and an indicator of deteriorating risk appetite in that market.

Equities.title: Record Quarter Primes India IPO Market for Blockbuster Year
Equities.reason: Strong IPO pipeline and issuance activity in India is a positive micro-to-macro signal for local equity market depth and sentiment. Moderately relevant as it offsets some souring signals but is region-specific.

Equities.title: IPO postponements are accelerating in third quarter, even beyond Oura
Equities.summary: It's been a strong year for IPOs. But now, more companies are deciding to stay on the sidelines.
Equities.reason: Rising IPO postponements signal deteriorating risk appetite and issuance conditions, reducing corporate supply-side optimism and signalling near-term caution in equity markets.

Equities.title: Nvidia doubles down on selling to both sides of the AI race
Equities.reason: Nvidia remains the central AI leadership trade; company strategy to capture both sides of the AI market is a strong positive for the dominant tech/AI equity narrative and buoyant large-cap leadership, with high market-signalling power.

Equities.title: Anthropic plans to spend $518 billion on AI infrastructure. Pre-IPO perps barely blink.
Equities.reason: Huge planned AI infrastructure investment by a major AI player supports the longer-term AI-led equity narrative (capex and revenue opportunity across suppliers). Relevant to sector leadership and investment cycles.

Equities.title: Russia targets data centers in Kyiv as NATO condemns Moscow’s ‘irresponsible nuclear rhetoric’
Equities.summary: Russia intensifies attacks on Ukraine’s data centers and communications infrastructure, targeting facilities in Kyiv.
Equities.reason: Escalation that targets tech infrastructure raises geopolitical risk and could pressure tech and European equities; notable tail-risk for market sentiment but not the dominant daily driver compared with rates/AI themes.

Rates.title: 30-year Treasury bond yield scales to highest level since 2002
Rates.summary: U.S. Treasury yields largely rose Tuesday, adding to the gains that catapulted them to multi-year highs amid central bank monetary policy concerns.
Rates.reason: Clear bond-market signal: multi-year highs in long-term Treasury yields imply a sustained bond sell-off and 'higher for longer' rate expectations driven by central-bank policy concerns — large negative for Rates.

Rates.title: Bond Yields Keep Rising Despite Drop in Oil Price, Dovish Fed Speech
Rates.reason: Reinforces dominant theme of rising long-end yields even when some disinflationary signals appear — suggests persistent inflation or risk premium pressure keeping yields higher (negative for bond prices).

Rates.title: Stocks dip, 2-year US yield falls after Fed's Williams cools rate hike bets
Rates.reason: Short-end yields falling after a Fed official signals rate hikes can wait is a counter-signal to the long-end selloff — modestly positive for short-dated Rates/liquidity expectations.

Rates.title: US core PCE inflation set to rise in August, pressuring the Federal Reserve
Rates.summary: The United States (US) Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) will publish the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index data for August on Wednesday at 12:30 GMT.
Rates.reason: Rising core PCE would reinforce Fed hawkishness and higher-for-longer rate expectations — negative for bond prices and supportive of continued yield upside.

Rates.title: Japan’s Two-Year Bond Sale Draws Stronger Demand on High Yields
Rates.reason: High yields in Japan are showing up in issuance/auction dynamics; while demand can absorb issuance, the underlying high-yield backdrop is negative for global fixed income sentiment.

Rates.title: Hedge funds hold a record share of the $30 trillion Treasury market. What could go wrong?
Rates.summary: Hedge funds can boost Treasury market liquidity, but their growing role also risks creating financial instability.
Rates.reason: Liquidity structure changes to the Treasury market (greater hedge fund share) raise the risk of episodic stress and amplify negative implications of rising yields — negative for market functioning and rates stability.

Rates.title: France’s 10-Year Bond Risk Premium Rises to 120 Basis Points
Rates.reason: Rising risk premium in French paper signals widening sovereign spreads and higher term premia in Europe — negative for Euro-area government bond prices and indicative of cross-border rates stress.

Rates.title: Morning Bid: A cruel quarter for bonds
Rates.reason: Macro commentary that bonds suffered materially over the quarter reinforces the dominant narrative of a broad bond selloff and higher term premia — negative for Rates.

Rates.title: Analysts see 10-year Treasury yield hitting 6%. Bitcoin bulls shouldn't panic
Rates.reason: Price-forecast style piece suggesting a material move higher in the 10yr reinforces expectations of continued yield upside; relevant to Rates but lower relevance as it's framed for crypto audience.

Rates.title: Dollar Powers to Best Month Since June on Fed’s Inflation Fight
Rates.reason: Dollar-strength narrative driven by Fed inflation-fighting supports the view that policy stays restrictive and yields remain elevated — indirect but relevant negative signal for global bond prices.

Rates.title: European shares set for first monthly loss in six as bond yields weigh
Rates.reason: Equity weakness explicitly attributed to rising bond yields underscores the market-wide impact of higher rates, though this is cross-asset transmission rather than pure rates market detail.

FX.title: US Dollar: Strength persists on higher yields – ING
FX.summary: ING strategists Francesco Pesole, Frantisek Taborsky and Chris Turner note the US Dollar remains strong despite softer US data, as rising long-dated US yields weigh on global risk sentiment and support the currency.
FX.reason: Clear USD-strength narrative driven by higher long-dated US yields and worse risk sentiment — negative for USD pairs (EURUSD/GBPUSD/AUDUSD/etc.). Important macro driver for FX flows.

FX.title: US Dollar: Fragile strength hinges on Fed – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Thu Lan Nguyen notes EUR/USD has dropped to its lowest level since mid-2025 as Dollar strength is driven by rising US rate expectations and a higher probability of an October Fed hike than an ECB move.
FX.reason: Reinforces USD-hawkish/Fed-expectations story that is weighing on EUR and other dollar crosses. High relevance but somewhat duplicative of yield/Fed theme.

FX.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Possibility of breakout above 101.80 hinges on US data
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) trades slightly lower against its key currency peers on Wednesday. At press time, the US Dollar Index (DXY), which gauges the Greenbacks value against six major currencies, is down 0.11% to near 101.28. Still, the asset is close to its two-
FX.reason: DXY near key levels; narrative is USD still elevated but conditional on upcoming US data. Moderately relevant for near-term USD vols and pair moves.

FX.title: Euro: EUR/USD Bearish risks toward 1.10 – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Francesco Pesole reports EUR/USD has broken below its summer lows, trading near 1.1350 as Dollar strength dominates. He sees limited scope for another large break unless the Federal Reserve hikes in October and stays hawkish, in which case EUR/USD could
FX.reason: Direct EUR/USD bearish call tied to Fed/higher-for-longer rates narrative — meaningful for EUR downside and USD strength across FX.

FX.title: Euro remains depressed near yearly lows amid soft German data
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) has trimmed some losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday but remains on the defensive, as data from the Eurozone fails to inspire, while France's ballooning debt starts to raise eyebrows.
FX.reason: Macro domestic eurozone weakness (soft German data, fiscal concerns) supporting USD vs EUR — straightforward negative for EUR/USD.

FX.title: Japanese Yen trims part of intraday gains vs retreating USD as traders await US PCE data
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair recovers a few pips from a one-and-a-half-week low, touched earlier this Wednesday, and trades just below the 157.00 mark during the first half of the European session, still down around 0.25% for the day.
FX.reason: USD/JPY remains lower on the day (JPY stronger) as markets position into US PCE — notable JPY strength relative to USD, relevant for G10 FX positioning and carry flows.

FX.title: Yen Strengthens Past 157 Per Dollar, Outperforming G-10 Peers
FX.reason: Material JPY outperformance vs G10 is a significant FX regime signal (impacts USD/JPY, risk flows and carry). High relevance for FX desks.

FX.title: British Pound moves away from two-month low after UK Q2 GDP as USD retreats ahead of PCE
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair attracts some buyers during the early European session on Wednesday and moves away from a two-month low, around the 1.3200 mark touched the previous day.
FX.reason: GBP/USD recovering as USD softens ahead of US data and UK GDP revision — positive for sterling vs USD in near term.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar gains as US Dollar declines on easing Fed rate hike bets
FX.summary: NZD/USD gains ground after registering losses in the previous day, trading around 0.5650 during the European hours on Wednesday. The pair gains upward momentum as the US Dollar (USD) weakens following dovish remarks from Federal Reserve Bank of New York Presid
FX.reason: NZD strength on reduced Fed-hike odds / USD retreat — EM/G10 cross reaction to US monetary expectations; modest relevance.

FX.title: Indian Rupee rebounds as traders reassess hawkish Fed bets, oil prices drop
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) gains against the US Dollar (USD) after a flat opening on Wednesday.
FX.reason: INR appreciation vs USD as markets pare Fed hawkishness and oil falls; relevant to EMFX flows but lower impact on G10/USD regime.

FX.title: Euro: EUR/USD risk reversal long setup – TD Securities
FX.summary: TD Securities' Macro Research Insight recommends going long EUR/USD via a three-month zero-cost risk reversal, buying a 1.1610-strike call and selling a 1.11-strike put.
FX.reason: Tactical options recommendation to express bullish EUR/USD — a technical/strategy signal with limited market-wide relevance relative to macro drivers.

Commodities.title: Gold Steady as Traders Weigh Lower Oil Against Higher Yields
Commodities.reason: Gold narrative dominated by higher real yields weighing on bullion despite offsets from lower oil/energy risk; overall slightly negative for gold prices given the yield headwind.

Commodities.title: Gold on track for monthly decline as investors brace for US inflation data
Commodities.reason: Headline points to falling gold amid expectations of stronger US inflation/PCE that could lift yields and pressure bullion — clear negative near-term macro for gold demand.

Commodities.title: Gold looks to build on gains above $4,200 on USD stays weak ahead of US PCE
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) attracts some buyers for the second straight day on Wednesday, with bulls now awaiting sustained strength and acceptance above the $4,200 mark before positioning for an extension of the recovery from an eight-week low, touched earlier this week.
Commodities.reason: Technical/price-driven piece showing USD softness and retreating yields providing support to gold; positive but limited relevance because it's a short-term price/technical story.

Commodities.title: Brent: Geopolitics and cracks drive Q3 surge – Rabobank
Commodities.summary: Rabobank highlights a sharp Q3 rally in Brent Oil, rising from $73 to $104, with the 3-2-1 crack spread jumping from $17 to $62. The effective move from $90 to $166 underscores tightening energy markets.
Commodities.reason: Rabobank highlights broad Q3 tightening — strong geopolitical and refinery/ crack-spread driven supply/processing constraints — a materially positive oil price narrative and important for energy markets.

Commodities.title: OPEC+ likely to maintain oil output targets at Sunday meeting - report
Commodities.reason: Maintaining current OPEC+ output targets implies continued supply restraint vs demand, supportive for oil prices; relevant to near-term energy supply outlook.

Commodities.title: WTI Price Forecast: Sticks to recovery gains below $89.00; lacks bullish conviction
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – edges higher on Wednesday, reversing a part of the previous day's heavy losses to an over three-week low, though it lacks follow-through.
Commodities.reason: Short-term technical/forecast note showing tentative recovery but limited conviction — marginally positive but low relevance per price-forecast classification.

Commodities.title: Oil Holds Decline as Middle East Exports Seen Near Pre-War Level
Commodities.reason: If Middle East exports are returning toward pre-war levels, that eases tightness and puts downward pressure on oil prices — a material negative for crude in the current supply-driven regime.

Commodities.title: White House holds crunch talks on diesel export ban as midterms near
Commodities.summary: Trump at centre of lobbying fight between Big Oil and top Republicans warning of voter anger at high fuel prices
Commodities.reason: Policy talks over a potential diesel export ban could tighten global product flows (or at least create supply-side uncertainty), supportive for fuel/oil price risk premia; relevant to energy markets and spreads.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD trades flat around $61.50, US data awaited
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) trades in a tight range at around $61.45 during the European trading session on Wednesday. The white metal consolidates as investors await the United States (US) Personal Consumption Expenditure (PCE) Price Index data for August, which w
Commodities.reason: Technical/near-term consolidation ahead of US PCE — little directional signal; low relevance as a price-forecast piece.

Commodities.title: Henry Hub natural gas prices this summer were 6% lower than last summer
Commodities.summary: The Henry Hub natural gas spot price averaged $2.93 per million British thermal units from June through August, 6% less than the same period last year. Prices were lower this summer despite exceptionally hot weather that increased electricity demand for air co
Commodities.reason: EIA data showing lower summer Henry Hub prices signals weaker gas tightness vs prior year — negative for natural gas price outlook into storage and seasonal considerations.

Crypto.title: Federal Reserve Board requests public comment on two proposals related to establishing a regulatory framework for Board-supervised payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act
Crypto.summary: Federal Reserve Board requests public comment on two proposals related to establishing a regulatory framework for Board-supervised payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act
Crypto.reason: Major US central bank engagement on stablecoin regulation is material for crypto: regulatory clarity and a supervised framework tends to be net-positive for institutional adoption and payment-rail use cases. High relevance because it's the Fed and stablecoins are core plumbing for crypto.

Crypto.title: Tether is a ‘lifeline’ for Iranian regime, Senate Dems say in new report
Crypto.reason: Allegations tying a major stablecoin to geopolitical sanctions risks raise material regulatory and compliance concerns. This increases political/regulatory scrutiny risk for the stablecoin ecosystem and broader crypto counterparties.

Crypto.title: Blockchain.com targets $500 million IPO this year at up to $6 billion valuation
Crypto.reason: A large-cap crypto-native firm pursuing a major IPO signals continued institutionalization and capital-market access for the industry, supportive for sentiment and fundraising.

Crypto.title: Chainlink launches new version of its crypto bridge tech 'CCIP' to give apps more control over their security
Crypto.reason: Improved bridge security and developer control addresses a top structural vulnerability (cross-chain hacks). Positive for infrastructure resilience and DeFi/app developer confidence.

Crypto.title: Near Intents blocks $50 million in Bitget hacker swaps, here's what happened
Crypto.reason: A protocol-level intervention that blocked large hacker swaps demonstrates emergent on-chain tooling for theft mitigation, which is constructive for market trust and loss prevention.

Crypto.title: THORChain rejects Bitget request to block hacker as $6 million moves to bitcoin
Crypto.reason: Decentralized cross-chain systems refusing to block hacker funds underlines limits to remediation and raises counterparty/security concerns; negative for confidence in certain non-custodial flows.

Crypto.title: Robinhood announces AI agent for customers that trades around the clock, plus 10x crypto perps
Crypto.reason: Retail brokerage adding AI trading agents and higher-leverage crypto products should lift trading volumes and retail participation — supportive for short-term flow and volatility, though with attendant risk.

Crypto.title: Live updates: Bitcoin turns lower as rates rise, consumer confidence plunges
Crypto.reason: Macro linkage: rising Treasury yields and risk-off macro data pressuring Bitcoin is a material cross-asset transmission channel — negative for crypto when rates and risk premium rise.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin rally shows signs of cooling even as a 'bull score' gauge nears its perfect score
Crypto.reason: Technical/momentum note pointing to cooling upside; relevant for near-term price action and trader positioning but lower structural relevance than macro or regulatory items.

Crypto.title: Zcash developers begin moving Tachyon code into faster private-payment software
Crypto.reason: Progress on privacy payment tech improves utility and throughput for privacy-centric crypto use cases; constructive for that segment though with potential regulatory sensitivity.

Crypto.title: Ethereum users get another way to pay privately as zk.money returns after three years
Crypto.reason: Return of a privacy payment option on Ethereum increases utility for private transfers and strengthens privacy tooling in the ecosystem; modestly positive.
